independence: Reviewer prepared the frozen source inventory and oracle, but did not author or modify the candidate. This is a static design review, not an oracle-isolated behavioral session.
review_basis: Frozen Java source corpus and its stated temporal limitations

checks.subject: Scope and discovery
checks.evidence: Description targets Lab Java responsibilities, interfaces and activation; simple build and unrelated repository explicitly excluded. Metadata agrees and default_prompt names $ss-java-module.

checks.subject: Actual architecture
checks.evidence: Monomodule maintained; package and role distinguished; concrete application-to-adapter dependencies visible; no invented port or installed ArchUnit.

checks.subject: J3 and worker authority
checks.evidence: Adopted J3 authority is preserved without a new permission requirement; no extension to other routes, fallback or implicit standard-browser startup.

checks.subject: Composition and coverage
checks.evidence: @Primary and reduced Spring test contexts distinguished; Maven sources/includes/Failsafe selection, current and historical evidence, and simulated/native tests separated.

checks.subject: Proportionality and references
checks.evidence: Outcomes and criteria leave implementation judgment; constraints address actual Lab boundaries; repository paths/class names are discoverable from worktree. No universal five-module redesign or implicit external action.

limitations: No behavioral case or native selection session run by this reviewer.
No application test, Maven, browser, worker or database launched.
Static PASS does not establish candidate qualification, human acceptance, or permission to install.
Review uses the already-read corpus and targeted candidate inspection; no exhaustive fresh repository audit.
